There is a desk (with one of the chairs) with USB plugs and an electrical outlet. When I said spacious, I do mean spacious for this not being one of their suites.

My only critique of the bath area is that the tub should have either more grab bars or the tub floor should have anti-slip strips.

The staff in the hotel is wonderful! Reception is very efficient both with check-in and check out. Questions were always answered with a smile and suggestions when requested.  The cocktail bar staff is friendly and attentive.

There is lemon water next to reception. After a day's walk about, a cold refreshing glass of water is most welcome.

Be sure to pay attention to their ecological conservation offers. You are rewarded with a beverage for delaying room service. This is a very creative idea to help conserve both water and energy.

I only have one small critical critique of one minor arrangement regarding the in-room coffee service. When we arrived, the in-room coffee bar only had 3 coffee pods - 1 intense, 1 normal and 1 decaffeinated.  Going down to reception to inquire of an extra coffee pod or two,  we were told that there would be a charge. However, if we waited until the next morning, housekeeping would provide any number of pods, no additional charge. This appears odd to me in that it delays the morning coffee "fix". Also, it was 10 at night and they had no one to bring them to the room (in a 4* NH Collection and there is no one to bring something to a guest's room?).
The lines for breakfast were epic. No matter how much they made you reserve breakfast time, it didn't matter. You came down at your time and you have to wait about 15/20 minutes to have breakfast.
In the breakfast room, the employees could not cope. They did everything they could, but there was a lack of personnel. There were free tables, and yet guests were waiting in the hallway to be able to have breakfast, and it is because the employees were not able to attend to the guests who were already inside, clean the tables and take the room number and let in those who were waiting.
"I didn't mind" waiting because it was a leisure trip, but if you go for work, that wait for breakfast can ruin your breakfast and you may have to rush or leave without breakfast.
The buffet was not as varied as it usually is at NHs (which is one of the reasons I choose this chain).
Also, the atmosphere in the breakfast room was super loud and stressful. It seemed like you were on a work day at the corner bar ordering breakfast. Nothing of the relaxed and calm atmosphere as is usually the case in 4* hotels and particularly in NH hotels (another reason why I choose this chain).
We booked with NH rewards and we did not have any privileges or any details or special treatment. I wonder what the point of being rewards is. In other NH Collections they have had some details for being rewards (for example, in the NH Collection Palacio de Oquendo -Caceres- they gave us a plate of fruit in the room and a welcome card and also in the room there was a kettle with coffee and infusions).
They gave us a very small attic room for two people. We complained and they moved us to another normal size room.
Those small attic rooms should be offered as economy rooms.
When we complained, we told reception that we had reserved a superior room and they told us that because it was NH Collection, all the rooms were superior. Well... The attic room had no point of comparison with the one they gave us later.
